Highlights:
Red Devil AMD Radeon™ RX 6600 XT 8GB GDDR6∣PowerColor

### Red Devil for the Best 1080p Gaming Experience

Based on AMD’s latest RDNA2 architecture, the PowerColor Red Devil Radeon™ RX 6600 XT not only inherits the merciless devilish look from existing Red Devil RX6000 series, but also our committed spirit in bringing out the best we can offer in products of all levels. With enhanced performance and cooling efficiency, PowerColor Red Devil Radeon™ RX 6600 XT is surely to provide gamers an uncompromising experience at 1080p gaming.

### Engineered for Performance and Reliability

PowerColor Red Devil RX 6600 XT equips with dual fan design (100mm x 100mm), a cooler with 4X6Φ nickel plated heatpipes, and a large nickel plated copper base. Moreover, the Red Devil RX 6600 XT features a state-of-the-art PCB design utilizing an 8+2 phase VRM with DrMOS, high polymer solid capacitors, and an 8+6 pin PCI-E connectors to offer the stable power supply.

1.Back Plate The metal back plate strengthens the card and offers better heat dissipation.

2.Dual BIOS Choose the BIOS mode that fits your need: better overclocking or silent operation.

3.DrMOS DrMOS provides superior power efficiency and better performance while high polymer solid capacitors offer uncompromising reliability. Red Devil is armed with an 8+2 phase VRM that guarantees better overclocking and stability for true gamers.

4.Cooler The cooler equips with 4X6Φ heatpipes and is larger than PCB surface by 13% to achieve better cooling efficiency.

5.Dual Fan The 2x 100mm optimized static pressure fan design provides more air flow and better cooling circulation.

6.RGB Featuring RGB on side, shroud, and back plate, the PowerColor Red Devil offers customized and personalized colors.

### Two-Ball Bearing - 4X greater longevity

The cooling fan utilizes two-ball bearing technology, increasing the longevity of the fans by up to 4 times.

### Mute Fan Technology - 0db –Silent gaming

Mute Fan Technology intelligently turns off the fan below 60℃, providing silent gaming during medium and low load while reducing power consumption.

### Exclusive New Cooling-Fan Design, Advanced Cooling Solution

Compared with previous generation, PowerColor Red Devil RX 6600 XT graphics card uses an exclusive new cooling-fan design to increase airflow and air pressure by up to 60%, achieving new level of thermal performance.

...

### Dual BIOS

With the flip of a switch, you can choose OC Mode which allows you to easily handle top-of-the-line games by pushing the limit of the power and performance, while Silent Mode provides an excellent quiet-gaming experience.

### RGB

Choose your unique RGB effect through our Keystone software, and light up the exquisite-looking Red Devil card! Additionally, Red Devil RGB can be seamlessly synced with your motherboard simply by connecting the two with an ARGB LED cable, allowing you to immerse yourself in a unique aesthetic atmosphere.

...

### PERFORMANCE TO LEVEL UP YOUR GAME

Introducing AMD Radeon™ RX 6600 XT graphics cards, featuring the breakthrough AMD RDNA™ 2 architecture. Engineered to deliver an incredible 1080p gaming experience, the AMD Radeon™ RX 6600 XT powers the next generation of gaming with vivid visuals and elevated experiences.

### Powerhouse Performance

AMD Radeon™ RX 6600 XT graphics cards deliver serious 1080p gaming and ultra-high frame rates. Get up to 32 high-performance compute units, groundbreaking AMD Infinity Cache, and up to 8GB of dedicated GDDR6 memory. Experience the next gen of gaming performance with AMD Smart Access Memory technology when you pair an AMD Radeon™ RX 6600 XT graphics card with an AMD Ryzen™ 5000 Series desktop processor.

### Vivid Visuals

With immersive gaming technologies and support for DirectX® 12 Ultimate, AMD Radeon™ RX 6600 XT graphics cards draw you into the action. Experience gaming with realistic lighting, shadows, and reflections along with rich detail, thanks to DirectX® Raytracing (DXR), variable rate shading (VRS), and AMD FidelityFX features, optimized for AMD RDNA™ 2 architecture.

### AMD Smart Access Memory Technology All AMD Performance. Built to Game.

Combine an AMD Ryzen 5000 Series processor or a select AMD Ryzen 3000 Series processor with an AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT graphics card to boost your system’s performance, thanks to AMD Smart Access Memory technology. AMD Smart Access Memory enables AMD Ryzen processors to harness the full potential of the graphics card memory. Enjoy increased performance with all-AMD in your system for the ultimate gaming advantage.

...

### GET A BOOST IN FRAMES FOR YOUR GAMES

AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR) boosts your frame rates 2.4X on average in FSR supported games with high-quality, high-resolution gaming experiences delivered by AMD Radeon RX 6000 Series graphics cards. Optimize your gaming experience between four presets, ranging from best visual fidelity to maximum performance.

Takes games to a new level of realism with support for features such as DirectX® Raytracing (DXR) and variable rate shading (VRS).

### 冷酷却勇猛的野兽：暗黑犬

撼讯暗黑犬RX6600XT，以AMD最新的RDNA2架构为核心，搭载更进化的性能及更有效率的散热系统，让玩家能轻松征服1080p游戏。利落的外观上配备银色外框点缀的100mm双风扇，就像低调静伏的猎犬，暗藏蓄势待发的能量。

### 暗黑犬的力量

为达到更优异的散热效果，暗黑犬 RX 6600XT具备2个100mm的风扇，3X6mm直径镀镍热管散热器，以及镜面镀镍铜质底座。更采用DrMOS 6+2相电压调节模块、固态电容以及一个8pin的PCI-E外接供电接口，实现更先进的游戏性能。

AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT 显卡采用突破性的 AMD RDNA 2 架构。 AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT 以生动视效和升级版性能打造下一代游戏体验，带您领略 1080P 游戏性能。

### 强大性能

AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT 显卡为您带来真正的 1080P 游戏体验和超高帧率。 搭载多达 32 个高性能计算单元，颠覆性的 AMD Infinity Cache 技术和高达 8GB GDDR6 专用显存。 搭配使用 AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT 显卡和 AMD 锐龙 5000 系列台式处理器，AMD 显存智取技术即可带您畅享新一代游戏体验。

### 生动的视觉效果

采用沉浸式游戏技术，并支持 DirectX® 12 Ultimate，AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT 显卡让您迅速进入状态。 借助 DirectX® 光线跟踪 (DXR)、可变速率着色 (VRS) 和针对 AMD RDNA 2 架构进行优化的 AMD FidelityFX 功能，您可以体验在逼真的光线、阴影和反射以及丰富的细节下游戏。
